department: Department of Climate, Meteorology & Atmospheric Sciences

deadline.value: Apply by January 5, 2027 for Fall 2027; assistantship offers go out January to May.
deadline.quote: MS and PhD Fall Application Submission: January 5

gre_subject.value: No subject GRE applies or is mentioned.

gre_general.value: The department's admission pages do not mention the GRE.

supervisor.value: The pages checked do not say whether you need an advisor before applying.

funding.value: Department policy is to offer an RA or TA to most admitted graduate students, usually with tuition and service fees waived.
funding.quote: It is the policy of the Department of Climate, Meteorology and Atmospheric Sciences to offer research or teaching assistantships to most of the graduate students accepted into the program.

entry_route.value: Applicants without an MS must enrol as MS students first, so with only a bachelor's you start in the MS.
entry_route.quote: *Please note that applicants without an M.S. must enroll as M.S. students.

notes: Spring entry also possible (October 15 deadline). Bachelor's in atmospheric science, physics, maths, CS, geography, engineering or related fields welcome for the MS.
